<description>
`wallet_send.py` had a commented-out TODO from the original `send` PR (#16378) about returning the hex when the fee rate is below the mempool minimum. The commented code was stale; `estimate_mode="sat/b"` no longer exists.

Also, an explicit `fee_rate` is only checked against `max(-mintxfee, -minrelaytxfee)`, not against `mempoolminfee` (see `src/wallet/fees.cpp`), so when the mempool is full, `send` can build a tx the node won't accept.

This PR adds a subtest covering this cases and removes the stale TODO.

With `add_to_wallet=false`, the returned hex is rejected by `testmempoolaccept`, and with `add_to_wallet=true`, `send` reports success, but the tx stays only in the wallet, not the mempool.
</description>
